phase_1.title: Phase 1 · M777A2 155 Firing Solenoid & Primer Ignition
phase_1.description: Closing the crew firing circuit energizes the breech firing pin, igniting the primary propellant charge inside the sealed 155mm NATO M795 / M982 Excalibur (39-Caliber) chamber.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 380 MPa Chamber Deflagration
phase_2.description: Rapid propellant burn drives chamber pressure to 380 MPa against the heavy locked breechblock while accelerating the heavy projectile.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 6045 mm Ordnance Acceleration
phase_3.description: Expanding gases accelerate the 155mm NATO M795 / M982 Excalibur (39-Caliber) round along the 6045 mm barrel up to 827 m/s (14,870,000 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Bore Clearance & Muzzle Blast
phase_4.description: The projectile clears the muzzle crown cleanly for engagements out to 30000 m while bore gases evacuate safely away from the crew.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Hydropneumatic Recoil Absorption
phase_5.description: Recoil cylinders absorb 46200 N-s of impulse smoothly across the cradle while transferring residual load into the chassis.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Breech Opening & Stub Extraction
phase_6.description: During battery runout, interrupted-screw breech seals 155mm chamber pressure while hydropneumatic buffers anchor recoil into titanium trails, ejecting the spent base stub cleanly into the deflector bin.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Munition Ramming & Battery Lock
phase_7.description: The next 155mm NATO M795 / M982 Excalibur (39-Caliber) round seats into the chamber and locks the breechblock back into firing readiness.

zh.headline: BAE M777A2 155mm 超轻型钛合金榴弹炮：2005 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: BAE M777A2 是人类首款大面积采用航空级钛合金与高强度铝合金铸焊炮架的 155mm 榴弹炮：全重仅 4,218 kg（比前代 M198 减重 41%），可由 V-22 鱼鹰或 CH-47 吊运部署，并在 40 公里外以数字火控引导“神剑”精确命中。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：M777A2 155 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 2005 年问世的 BAE M777A2 155mm 超轻型钛合金榴弹炮 由英国 / 美国BAE 系统公司（巴罗因弗内斯）主导研制，定位为经典的155mm 钛合金超轻型牵引榴弹炮。M777A2 作为馆藏第 100 号收官巨炮，将轻武器、弓弩、1:1 主战坦克与重型野战炮兵的机械演进史完整串联成跨越六百余年（1415–2026）的百年军械百科全书。

BAE M777A2 是人类首款大面积采用航空级钛合金与高强度铝合金铸焊炮架的 155mm 榴弹炮：全重仅 4,218 kg（比前代 M198 减重 41%），可由 V-22 鱼鹰或 CH-47 吊运部署，并在 40 公里外以数字火控引导“神剑”精确命中。 整件装备总长 10,700 mm（战斗展开全长 · 行军 9,500 mm）、空重 4218 kg，成为同期航空重武领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。2005 年，英国 / 美国BAE 系统公司（巴罗因弗内斯）推出了划时代的BAE M777A2 155mm 超轻型钛合金榴弹炮。M777A2 作为馆藏第 100 号收官巨炮，将轻武器、弓弩、1:1 主战坦克与重型野战炮兵的机械演进史完整串联成跨越六百余年（1415–2026）的百年军械百科全书。 它的核心设计聚焦于大规模航空级钛合金摇架与前伸稳定驻锄，全重 4.2 吨可直升机吊运，奠定了其在航空重武发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 炮尾摇架与耳轴承力机匣

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: BAE M777A2 155mm 超轻型钛合金榴弹炮 的机械灵魂在于其「分装式断隔螺式炮闩 · 液气双驻退复进筒 · 全钛合金低重心炮架」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，螺式炮闩闭锁 155mm 高压药室，发射后液气驻退机经钛合金大架导力入地，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用哑光航空级钛合金与高强度 CNC 铝合金精加工而成。低耳轴高度几何设计将 155mm 巨大后坐力直接导入双开大架驻锄，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。BAE M777A2 155mm 超轻型钛合金榴弹炮 采用分装式断隔螺式炮闩 · 液气双驻退复进筒 · 全钛合金低重心炮架。在每个击发周期中，螺式炮闩闭锁 155mm 高压药室，发射后液气驻退机经钛合金大架导力入地。借助哑光航空级钛合金与高强度 CNC 铝合金工艺与高强度配合，实现了低耳轴高度几何设计将 155mm 巨大后坐力直接导入双开大架驻锄。
acts.focusPartLabel: 重型立楔/螺式主炮炮闩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 155mm NATO M795 / M982 Excalibur (39-Caliber) 弹药规格与 6,045 mm（155mm L/39 · 48 条右旋膛线 · 双室高效制退器），最高工作膛压约 380 MPa，可赋予弹头 827 m/s 的出膛初速与 14,870,000 J 动能，有效作用距离达 30000 米。
内膛技术特点方面，155mm M776 L/39 镀铬 48 条深膛线身管，兼容模块化装药与 GPS 制导“神剑”炮弹。同时，双室高效膛口制退器配合左右双液气驻退复进筒吸收近半后坐冲量，令其在 5 发/分（急促射 · 2 发/分持续射） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 6045 毫米身管与 155mm NATO M795 / M982 Excalibur (39-Caliber) 口径，BAE M777A2 155mm 超轻型钛合金榴弹炮 实现了每秒 827 米的初速与 30000 米有效射程。155mm M776 L/39 镀铬 48 条深膛线身管，兼容模块化装药与 GPS 制导“神剑”炮弹，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 1 发容量的分装炮弹与模块化发射药装填台与 1380 mm 膛轴设计，BAE M777A2 155mm 超轻型钛合金榴弹炮 将单发后坐冲量控制在 46200 N·s 水平。A2 型集成数字化火控（DFCS）与感应装定器，支持 40 km 神剑精确打击。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-100）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 1 发容量的分装炮弹与模块化发射药装填台与出色的整体工效，A2 型集成数字化火控（DFCS）与感应装定器，支持 40 km 神剑精确打击。欢迎在 BAY-100 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 BAE M777A2 155mm 超轻型钛合金榴弹炮 的机械魅力。

en.deck: The first 155mm howitzer built extensively from aerospace titanium-alloy castings, the BAE M777A2 slashes weight by 41% to 4,218 kg for CH-47 and V-22 sling-load mobility while guiding M982 Excalibur GPS shells out to 40 km via digital fire control. acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the M777A2 155
paragraphs: Introduced in 2005 by BAE Systems Global Combat Systems in United Kingdom / United States, the BAE M777A2 155mm Ultralightweight Howitzer emerged as a defining 155mm Titanium Ultralightweight Howitzer. Crowning Bay 100 of the museum, the M777A2 bridges small arms, medieval archery, 1:1 main battle tanks, and modern titanium field artillery across six centuries of mechanical engineering (1415–2026).

The first 155mm howitzer built extensively from aerospace titanium-alloy castings, the BAE M777A2 slashes weight by 41% to 4,218 kg for CH-47 and V-22 sling-load mobility while guiding M982 Excalibur GPS shells out to 40 km via digital fire control. Measuring 10,700 mm (combat deployed · 9,500 mm towed) at an unloaded weight of 4218 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Aviation & Heavy Ordnance class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 2005, BAE Systems Global Combat Systems of United Kingdom / United States introduced the BAE M777A2 155mm Ultralightweight Howitzer. Crowning Bay 100 of the museum, the M777A2 bridges small arms, medieval archery, 1:1 main battle tanks, and modern titanium field artillery across six centuries of mechanical engineering (1415–2026). Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Aerospace titanium cradle and split trails cut weight to 4,218 kg for helicopter lift — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the BAE M777A2 155mm Ultralightweight Howitzer sits its Separate-Loading Interrupted-Screw Breech · Hydro-Pneumatic Recoil · Titanium Carriage. Throughout every firing cycle, interrupted-screw breech seals 155mm chamber pressure while hydropneumatic buffers anchor recoil into titanium trails, containing 380 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in matte aerospace titanium alloy and billet aluminum, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Low-trunnion geometry channels massive 155mm recoil loads straight into ground spades, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The BAE M777A2 155mm Ultralightweight Howitzer relies on Separate-Loading Interrupted-Screw Breech · Hydro-Pneumatic Recoil · Titanium Carriage. During each cycle, interrupted-screw breech seals 155mm chamber pressure while hydropneumatic buffers anchor recoil into titanium trails. Machined from matte aerospace titanium alloy and billet aluminum, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Low-trunnion geometry channels massive 155mm recoil loads straight into ground spades.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 155mm NATO M795 / M982 Excalibur (39-Caliber) with 6,045 mm (155mm L/39 · 48-Groove RH · Double-Baffle Brake), the BAE M777A2 155mm Ultralightweight Howitzer develops 827 m/s muzzle velocity and 14,870,000 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 30000 meters.

Internally, 155mm M776 L/39 chrome-lined 48-groove rifled barrel supporting modular charges and Excalibur GPS shells. Combined with its 5 RPM (burst · 2 RPM sustained) tempo, Double-baffle muzzle brake and dual hydro-pneumatic cylinders tame 46 kN·s impulse, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 155mm NATO M795 / M982 Excalibur (39-Caliber) through its 6045 millimeter bore, the BAE M777A2 155mm Ultralightweight Howitzer achieves 827 meters per second and 30000 meters of effective reach. 155mm M776 L/39 chrome-lined 48-groove rifled barrel supporting modular charges and Excalibur GPS shells.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 1-round 155mm loading tray & charge cradle with a 1380 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 46200 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Digital Fire Control System (DFCS) and inductive fuze setter support 40 km Excalibur.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-100), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 1-round 155mm loading tray & charge cradle with disciplined recoil geometry, Digital Fire Control System (DFCS) and inductive fuze setter support 40 km Excalibur. Explore BAY-100 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the BAE M777A2 155mm Ultralightweight Howitzer.
